topic: Project background and relationship to Gatun power station
wiki_text: The Telfers FSRU was proposed circa 2013 by Panama NG Power (a unit of LNG Group Panama) as part of an integrated LNG-import-to-power scheme on Telfers Island, Colon, pairing a floating import terminal with a combined-cycle power plant. The power plant's ASEP generation license was granted in 2014, revoked the same year, reinstated by a Panamanian Supreme Court ruling in 2016, and then declared expired by ASEP in late 2017 after the sponsor missed its financial-close deadline. No FSRU vessel was ever chartered before the scheme lapsed. The power-plant site was later completed under a different financing structure and now operates as Gatun power station, supplied by regasified LNG piped from the onshore Costa Norte LNG Terminal rather than a dedicated FSRU -- resolving an earlier open researcher question on the Costa Norte record about a possible link to an earlier project iteration.
